A '''civil war''' embroiled the [[Croke]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Croke Reach]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] for several generations. After some factions unleashed [[Lugubraa]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] upon their foes, the insatiable [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] not only wrought havoc on their targets' [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], but also those of their employers. The Croke petitioned the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] a new strain of Lugubraa to fight back their mainline cousins. This new batch consisted of Lugubraa known as [[blind berserker]]s; however, it proved just as dangerous and uncontrollable. The Croke found themselves fighting to avoid extinction against the new force, which the Croke Reach natives called the [[Leech Legion]].

==History==
[[File:Lugubraa-TUR.png|thumb|right|220px|Croke factions unleashed Lugubraa mercenaries upon their foes.]]
A civil war erupted amongst factions of the [[Croke]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who inhabited the [[Croke Reach]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. During these hostilities, some Croke groups utilized [[Lugubraa]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] against their enemies, hoping the ravenous marauders would decimate their targets' [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The technique backfired, as the Lugubraa proved even more successful than had been intended and turned on their masters' worlds as well. After several generations, the Croke, regardless of their side in the civil war, found themselves fighting the Lugubraa to secure their very survival.<ref name="TUR" />

The Croke turned to the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] of the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for help against the Lugubraa menace. They commissioned genetically-modified Lugubraa [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to turn on their mainline brethren, and the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] sold them a strain of Lugubraa known as the [[blind berserker]]s. Nevertheless, this new force&mdash;dubbed the "[[Leech Legion]]" by the Croke&mdash;also proved more destructive than anticipated.<ref name="TUR" /><ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Among the Croke planets affected by the Lugubraa was [[Explume Minor]], where the [[Shell Conjurer]] [[Firtha]] ordered the cloaking of Croke [[Youngling/Legends|nestlings]]&mdash;using the species' inherent [[Mind trick/Legends|illusion]]-casting ability&mdash;and their subsequent evacuation. Hostilities with the Lugabraa continued long after the civil war that sparked them had ended.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Croke civil war is described in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a sourcebook published in [[2010]] for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|Saga Edition]] of the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' from [[Wizards of the Coast]]. The book places the war "more than 300 years ago";however, because the book is designed for use in any [[Time/Legends|time]] period from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] to the [[Legacy era]], the precise dating of the war cannot be determined.<ref name="TUR" /> The section of the book that describes the war was written by [[Daniel Wallace]], who used it as an opportunity to expand on the background of not only the Croke species, but also the Leech Legion, a group he introduced in his [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="Wallace">{{Blog|danwallace|168|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions}}.</ref>
